examples.name: Basic multi-line field
examples.description: A labelled text area. Pair it with a native label the same way as any form control; set `rows` for the initial height.
examples.jsx:
<label htmlFor="notes">Notes</label>
<TextArea id="notes" rows={4} placeholder="Add a description" />

examples.name: Controlled with a character count
examples.description: Standard controlled pattern - hold the value and cap it with the native maxLength, showing a count in a helper line.

examples.name: Sizes and appearances
examples.description: size controls padding/radius/font; appearance switches between the bordered box and the low-chrome subtle variant (transparent until interacted with).
examples.jsx:
<TextArea size="md" aria-label="Medium" rows={3} />
<TextArea size="lg" aria-label="Large" rows={3} />
<TextArea appearance="subtle" aria-label="Subtle" rows={3} />

examples.name: Invalid and disabled
examples.description: invalid sets aria-invalid and the error border; disabled greys the frame and locks the resize grip.
examples.jsx:
<TextArea invalid aria-label="Invalid" rows={3} defaultValue="Needs attention" />
<TextArea disabled aria-label="Disabled" rows={3} defaultValue="Read only" />

examples.name: Fixed height, no resize
examples.description: resize="none" locks the height for tight layouts; content scrolls natively when it overflows.

antiExamples.name: Using Text Area for a single line
antiExamples.reason: A single-line value belongs in Text Field, which gives the right keyboard/enter semantics and icon slots. Text Area is for genuinely multi-line content.

antiExamples.name: No accessible name
antiExamples.reason: A placeholder is not a label - it disappears on input and is not a reliable accessible name. Wire a <label htmlFor> or pass aria-label, the same as any native form control.

antiExamples.name: Expecting inline tags or formatting
antiExamples.reason: Text Area is plain text only - `/` is a literal character here. The inline entity-tagging mode (`type=rich-inline` in Figma) ships as RichTextArea; use that when the text needs to link to records.
